integrity.finite_verification: Standalone Python 3 standard-library-only checker; stored exact output; no random sampling or floating arithmetic.
integrity.proof_methods: Integral 24x24 determinant and binary rank; Smith normal form parity argument; symbolic lower-triangular reduction; complete finite-ring polynomial witness check.
integrity.unproved_limits: No universal minimum-degree assertion across all finite rings, and no independent external audit.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns one specified 128-element characteristic-four tiled matrix ring, not all finite rings.
The ring and existence of sextic counterexample are already established in Wu, arXiv:2609.01150; the asserted addition is a sharp degree lower bound and parity stability.
Degree-five obstruction uses an exact finite integer certificate with proof by Smith normal form; the finite exhaustive witness test covers precisely all 128 elements.
Absolute historical priority is not independently established.
title: Sharp degree-six onset of right instability in a 128-element tiled matrix ring
